lemmas.primary_translation: acute angle; in team sports, a tight angle near the goal line

definitions.text: i lagspill: utgangspunkt for spark, kast eller skudd langt nede mot dødlinje daudlinje på siden av målet
definitions.translation: in team sports: a position for a kick, throw, or shot far down near the goal line at the side of the goal

examples.en: shoot the ball from a tight angle
